messages.subject: Mitten sizing
messages.text:
Greetings, I’m interested in ordering mittens and my measurements are between two sizes. 19 cm length and 9 cm wide. Would you recommend a size medium or large. Thank you!

Nancy Vermilyea

Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: Re: Mitten sizing
messages.text:
Hello Nancy,
 

 Thank you for your message and for sharing your measurements 😊
 

 Since your hand measurements fall between two sizes, the best way for us to recommend the most accurate fit would be to validate together.
 

 Could you please send us a few photos of your hands next to a ruler (as shown in the reference images attached)?
 

 This allows us to properly assess proportions, which is often more reliable than numbers alone when someone falls between sizes.
 

 Once we receive the photos, we’ll gladly recommend whether medium or large would be the better option for you.
 

 Looking forward to helping you choose the perfect fit!
 

 Warm regards,
 

 Lasclay
